characters.prompt: Production movement animation sprite sheet by editing the supplied approved Cinder ghost chef. Preserve EXACT character identity and polished hand-painted game art: small translucent lavender ghost with big dark oval eyes, cute smile, cream puffy chef hat, burgundy neckerchief/waistcoat, cream pumpkin embroidered apron, wooden spoon in RIGHT hand, plate of orange pastry with cream and steam in LEFT hand. He has NO LEGS, NO FEET: wispy ghost tail underneath, a floating movement cycle. One transparent square RGBA image, 8 columns x 8 rows, exactly64 complete separate figures on a perfectly regular grid, no text, no borders, no floor shadows. All figures same body scale/hat height, clear transparent margins; 2048x2048 if possible. Each row is an eight-frame floating travel cycle: tail curls left, lifts, swings through centre, curls right, rightmost tail, dips, swings through centre, curls left; gentle body bob, subtle opposite arm sway and steam wisps, keeps plate level. This is NOT a repeated idle pose. Eight true body viewing directions: row1 FRONT directly facing viewer; row2 FRONT-RIGHT diagonal, face clearly toward RIGHT EDGE OF IMAGE →; row3 PURE RIGHT PROFILE, face and spoon point RIGHT EDGE →; row4 BACK-RIGHT diagonal, see BACK and tiny right-side cheek, moving away towards RIGHT EDGE →; row5 ONLY BACK of hat/head/waistcoat and apron ties, NO FACE visible; row6 BACK-LEFT diagonal moving away towards LEFT EDGE ←; row7 PURE LEFT PROFILE, face points LEFT EDGE ←; row8 FRONT-LEFT diagonal, face toward LEFT EDGE ←. Rows2/3/4 must face opposite direction from6/7/8! Whole body rotates and asymmetrical spoon/plate stay in anatomical hands, not simple reflected front art. All64 individually painted animation frames; consistent camera about10degrees above horizontal and consistent lighting. No background, no captions, no grid lines.
limitations: Legless ghost: eight authored tail/arm/steam floating phases, no footsteps.
Rear-left view is subtle; designed as an eight-sector authored approximation, not photogrammetric 45-degree rotation.
characters.review: Approved after visual direction review: front, right-facing front/profile/rear, back, left-facing rear/profile/front. 64 connected character components. Outer-edge alpha below32; no opaque canvas clipping.
